title: Trial of Toil
function: Usefulness, dignity, respect, responsibility, and the beginning of meaningful contribution.

preserve: Older usefulness/work function: dependence, pride, competence, contribution, being needed.
The Oracle's Couch as the surviving slot for counseling/interior reckoning.
DTI has temporal refugees from many eras and can plausibly operate support services for them.
supersede: Community College as a locked Issue 6 anchor.
DMV/drivers-license material as a required integration or employment chain.
A second permanent-ID quest that duplicates the season's residency/recognition arc.
Earlier Oracle's Couch psychiatric-evaluation/body-clinic interpretations where they conflict with the support-group development.

bjornArc.setup: After Issue 5 shows the Vikings becoming known and cared for in their neighborhood, Bjorn becomes increasingly distressed by receiving care without an equivalent way to contribute. His old identity was built around providing, deciding, protecting, and carrying responsibility for other people.
bjornArc.rupture: Bjorn lashes out badly enough that Carrie treats the behavior as a real risk rather than another comic misunderstanding.
bjornArc.carrieAction: Carrie brings Bjorn to a DTI temporal-refugee support group.
bjornArc.groupConcept: The group contains temporal refugees displaced from widely different eras. It must feel like an ordinary ongoing support group, not a parade of historical archetypes assembled to teach Bjorn a lesson.
bjornArc.1980sParticipant: One participant is from the 1980s and does not think they really belong in the group because, from their perspective, they are not from that long ago. The beat is funny but also establishes that displacement trauma is not proportional to historical distance.
bjornArc.bjornParticipation: Bjorn takes the group much more seriously than most participants. He listens as if people are bringing matters before council. He notices contradictions, refuses comfortable evasions, and challenges the group leader intellectually because he is genuinely engaged rather than hostile to the process.
bjornArc.groupLeader: The group leader is competent and secure enough to challenge Bjorn back rather than shutting him down, infantilizing him, or treating him as a curiosity. Their intellectual friction becomes one of Bjorn's first modern relationships built on adult respect.
bjornArc.emergentLeadership: Other participants begin looking toward Bjorn in very small ways: asking what he thinks, responding when he asks a serious question, remembering something he said, noticing his absence, or accepting his steadiness. They do not become dependent on him. Bjorn simply begins functioning as a leader because leadership is one of his real talents.
bjornArc.needOne: Respect: the group leader treats Bjorn's thinking as worth arguing with.
bjornArc.needTwo: Meaning: the group begins to value Bjorn's presence and leadership in small, authentic ways.
bjornArc.result: Bjorn accidentally thrives. His first meaningful modern contribution is not physical labor, paperwork, or a contrived modern credential. It is leadership.
bjornArc.employmentRule: Do not immediately convert this into employment. The group must matter to Bjorn before anyone monetizes or formalizes his contribution. Only later may this naturally become paid peer support, temporal-refugee orientation, group assistance, or another non-clinical role that uses his lived experience and leadership without pretending he has become a licensed therapist.

issueBridge.issue6Question: What does Bjorn have to offer this place, and can contribution take a form he did not previously recognize as work?
issueBridge.towardFinale: The group and later usefulness arc create real evidence that Bjorn is not merely being supported by New York; his presence has begun to matter to other people.

guardrails: Do not frame therapy itself as the lesson Bjorn must learn.
Do not make Bjorn a therapist or give him clinical authority.
Do not make other refugees dependent on Bjorn.
Do not turn the group leader into a passive foil who exists to be defeated by Bjorn.
Do not make every temporal refugee an exposition device or historical caricature.
Do not rush the support-group success into a job offer.
Do not restore Community College or DMV as causal prerequisites unless later development independently earns them.
